name: admin.conversations.linkObjects
purpose: Link a Salesforce record to a channel

channel.desc: Channel ID for Slack channel that will be linked to a Salesforce record.

record_id.desc: Salesforce record ID (15 or 18 digit accepted). See here for how to look up record ID.

salesforce_org_id.desc: Salesforce org ID (15 or 18 digit accepted). See here for how to look up Salesforce org ID.

'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.
